triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: 一条确定性生命周期回归证明四项计数均为 0 且 DONE prepare PASS，同时真实漂移和篡改仍 fail-closed。
acceptanceBindings.note: Binds one-pass convergence, independent fail-closed artifact gates, and declaration-aware concept behavior to representative must intents; all 38 must intents remain required by checklist coverage.

note: Review retention is not artifact admissibility; this contract does not weaken any closeout gate.
